name: Tic-tac-toe board
blurb: A wooden game board with raised lines. Use bottle caps or painted rocks for X and O.

steps.text: Measure and mark the square base on the 1x10.
Cut the base from the 1x10, then two long strips and six short strips from the 1x2.
Mark where the strips go on the base (see the cut sheet and picture).
Glue the strips on the lines and clamp them.
